title: Single host-authenticated HTTP system-view route for Command Unified Work Queue
goal: Expose all six existing first-party Command Work Queue system views via one read-only HTTP GET path using a host-resolved current session and the existing owner ACL; no new view engine.
invariants: One GET /command/work-queue route, exact six existing views; `view` remains a parameter, not six routes.
Host resolves current principal, tenant, environment independently of all untrusted client query/header fields; existing Owner.CanRead checked per Incident/Task.
No Shared Saved View storage, client IAM, object mutation, linked Case/Decision/Run permission cloning or production claims.
security_properties: Reject all client-selected scope and unknown/multiple view fields at the HTTP entry boundary.
Owner errors, revoked access and missing session must not produce partial data, object IDs or an authorization shortcut.
No response caching, no unsafe HTML, 5000 candidate/50 response bound inherited from existing first-party Project.

migration.rationale: An opt-in HTTP adapter over a previous nonpersistent read-only Go service

rollback.strategy: Stop wiring the new opt-in HTTP handler; existing Work Queue projection remains unchanged

inputs: Canonical CAP-CMD-101 §§1-27; Command saved-views catalogue exact six views and route invariant
Existing Command-owned workqueue.Project first-party owner authorization, explicit open questions on Shared Saved Views and final workspace
Existing permission/tenant owner contracts, no valid host IAM provider in this draft
outputs: Go standard-library NewHTTPHandler accepting SessionResolver and existing Owner interfaces
GET /command/work-queue?view=... delivers six authorized existing view projections, GET absent view defaults All; no separate view routes
Host identity scope is never accepted from user query; no authenticated host → no data; host/provider access failure is all-or-nothing
Real HTTP tests for six view keys, no scope injection, missing identity, owner revocation, invalid method and route; CI and independent targeted L2
acceptance_tests: Existing six canonical Work Queue views are accessible through exactly one route using a trusted host-provided scope, with current owner ACL per item
No independent incident/tasks routes or revived team-load; query principal/tenant/environment and duplicated view rejected
Missing/revoked host identity and provider failure return no data or partial IDs
Exact SHA Linux, macOS, Windows Go unit tests and mandatory engineering kernel (including unchanged >=90% changed-security coverage) must succeed before any merger
No claim of production cookie/session, Shared Saved Views/Inspector, full queue workspace, persistence, assignment, paging or CAP acceptance

performance_budget.rationale: Reuses already bounded first 5000 candidates/50 response Work Queue projection; this HTTP boundary adds only one JSON encoding
metrics: At most 5000 owner candidates and 50 response rows
No unbounded new backend loop or external API calls

definition_of_ready: E10-CMD-101A-READONLY IMPLEMENTED, explicit opt-in Class-0 read-only route, host SessionResolver and Owner boundaries clear; no decisions about Saved View writes assumed
Canonical CAP-CMD-101 exact six views and single route contract validated
definition_of_done: Separate PR with exact-head required CI and real six-view HTTP behavioral/deny tests; one independent L2 on material host authentication boundary
Remains IMPLEMENTED pending CI, independent review and native PR approvals; no product acceptance
